description: Connect the original dragon region to the real Timber Room without replacing the canonical east/west mine routes.

replacements.old:
<ROOM TIMBER-ROOM	;"was TIMBE"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Timber Room")
      (EAST TO LADDER-BOTTOM)
      (WEST TO LOWER-SHAFT
       IF EMPTY-HANDED
       ELSE "You cannot fit through this passage with that load.")
      (ACTION FIRE-TIMBER-ROOM-FCN)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT SACREDBIT)>
replacements.new:
<ROOM TIMBER-ROOM	;"was TIMBE"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Timber Room")
      (EAST TO LADDER-BOTTOM)
      (WEST TO LOWER-SHAFT
       IF EMPTY-HANDED
       ELSE "You cannot fit through this passage with that load.")
      (NORTH TO DRAGON-APPROACH)
      (ACTION FIRE-TIMBER-ROOM-FCN)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT SACREDBIT)>
